rubric.explanation: Economic: output/jobs/funded obligations 40/30/30. Social: occupied housing/essential services/resilience 40/40/20; five equal service subweights. Environment: cover/reference-storm reduction/low-emissions supply/water pressure 40/25/20/15. All components cap at demand; no placement points. Targets and scenario quantities are pinned in this definition.

economy.assumptions: Scenario units, not measured population or utilities. Existing community: 4 homes, 4 jobs, 4 recreation, 4 local-service units. Drinking-water supply remains fixed; wastewater plants do not produce drinking water.
